sst.product: MUR SST v4.1 (NASA JPL) via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
sst.level: L4 daily gap-filled analysis of satellite observations, 0.01 deg

chl.product: NOAA VIIRS (S-NPP + NOAA-20) chlorophyll-a, DINEOF gap-filled, NRT, via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
chl.level: L4 daily, ~9 km; cloud gaps filled statistically (DINEOF) from surrounding days and areas

sst_front.product: Derived from MUR SST: gradient magnitude

factors.chl: Bell curve in log space centred on 0.2 mg/m3 (sd 0.35 decades): productive-boundary water in the oligotrophic Indian Ocean; very clear or very green water scores lower. Not used within ~4 km of water shallower than 30 m, where seabed reflection biases satellite chlorophyll.
factors.sst: Trapezoid: 0 below 20 C, rising to 1 at 24 C, 1 up to 29.5 C, easing to 0.6 at 31.5 C (skipjack/yellowfin surface preference; warmer surface water pushes tuna deeper).
factors.front: Strongest SST gradient within ~4 km (smoothed), scaled so 0.06 C/km or more scores 1 (thermal fronts concentrate prey).
factors.structure: exp(-distance / 8 km) to the nearest seamount, knoll, pinnacle or drop-off candidate (underwater structure aggregates baitfish).

validation.reason: No catch records yet; the logbook (Phase 5) will provide them.

params.explanation: 30-300 m on sloping seabed (>= 6 deg on the ~460 m GEBCO grid): the depth band used for vertical and slow-pitch jigging along reef edges and drop-offs.
